description: This file defines the Affiliate model class for the OpenCart admin module, containing methods to manage customer affiliate records, including adding, editing, deleting, retrieving, and reporting functionalities.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Model class for managing customer affiliate data within the Opencart administration system.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Creates a new affiliate record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates an existing affiliate record identified by customer ID with new data.

methods.name: editBalance
methods.description: Updates the balance of a specific customer affiliate record.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Removes an affiliate record associated with the given customer ID and deletes related reports.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves the affiliate record for a specific customer, including custom fields and status.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Fetches affiliate data based on the tracking string.

methods.name: getAffiliates
methods.description: Returns a list of affiliates, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAffiliates
methods.description: Returns the total count of affiliate records matching specified filters.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Fetches affiliate report records for a customer with pagination support.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all report records associated with a customer ID.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the count of report records for a specific customer.
